answer: The oasis edge is written down both ways, so a closed ring of 162 clones produces a signature the ocean analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Anyone must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the atlas settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 29 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
